commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
90+1' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
90+1' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) brought his opponent down. Eintracht Frankfurt get a free kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
88' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
88' The attendance is 30660.

87' Great save! Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Kevin Trapp. Now Augsburg have a corner.
86' Here comes a substitution. Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Alexis Claude-Maurice.
83' Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
81' The referee awards a corner and Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take it.

81' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Finn Dahmen pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Eintracht Frankfurt are going to take it.
81' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
79' Here comes a substitution. Marius Wolf is given a rest as he is replaced by Henri Koudossou (Augsburg).
79' Referee Florian Badstubner halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Dino Toppmoller, then shows him a yellow.

78' Rasmus Kristensen nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
77' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

77' Finn Dahmen pulls off a great save to deny Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!

75' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ansgar Knauff, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
75' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

74' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner.
73' A cross is whipped into the box by Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Hugo Ekitike controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
72' Marius Wolf swings in the free kick towards Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg), who powers a header high over the bar from close in.
72' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
70' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.

69' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
68' Nathaniel Brown floats over the corner and Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the left post.
68' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
68' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. It will be a corner kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
66' Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
64' Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
63' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the right post.
61' Mert Komur comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg).
61' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) replaces Samuel Essende.
59' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
56' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Arthur Theate walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt).
55' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
55' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
54' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Finn Dahmen pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
53' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the left post.
51' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
51' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the bottom right corner, but Finn Dahmen was alert and made an amazing save!
46' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
46' Dino Toppmoller has made a change at the break. Ansgar Knauff has come on in place of Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replaced by Jean-Matteo Bahoya.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
45+2' Augsburg earn a corner.
45+2' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kevin Trapp, who smothers the ball. Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+1' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' There's a distinct lack of options for Mert Komur (Augsburg), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
43' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) sprays a pass out to Michy Batshuayi, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
42' The corner by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

40' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
40' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
40' The fouls committed statistics – 1:3.
37' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Hugo Ekitike, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
36' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Samuel Essende (Augsburg) offside.
35' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
33' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a throw-in.

32' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long ball forward to Rasmus Kristensen, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
30' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
26' 5:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
26' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
25' The game is interrupted now, Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
23' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
22' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
21' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.

19' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
19' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to find Hugo Ekitike, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
16' Mert Komur (Augsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
14' The corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared away by the defence.

13' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
12' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

10' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
10' A clumsy foul by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Augsburg.
9' A crossfield pass from Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
8' Augsburg are ruled offside.
8' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
5' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle after Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
5' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

4' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a long ball to Rasmus Kristensen, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
3' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
2' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) picks out Mert Komur with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
